title: デイリー杯ジュニアSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My biggest opponent today is Mejiro Bright. She stands before me as a representative of the Mejiro family, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Races are lonesome and isolating things! The truly strong take on races without relying on their families. So who's going to shine the brightest today? That's right! Me!
